title: Limb Length and Girth — True, Apparent and Functional Leg Length, Swelling and Wasting

hook.en: A centimetre decides whether a leg is truly short, whether the pelvis is tilted or whether the knee is swollen. Learn tape-measure rules that make every number repeatable.
hook.ur: Ek centimetre tay karta hai ke taang waqai chhoti hai, pelvis tilt hai ya knee sooja hua hai. Tape-measure ke woh usool seekhein jo har number ko repeatable banate hain.

goal.en: By the end, you'll measure true and apparent leg length, thigh, knee and calf girth and figure-of-eight ankle swelling, and tell structural from functional discrepancy.
goal.ur: End tak aap true aur apparent leg length, thigh, knee aur calf girth aur figure-of-eight ankle swelling naapenge, aur structural ko functional discrepancy se alag karenge.

text.en: A tape measure is only trustworthy with **five habits**: mark the landmarks with a skin pen, measure **both sides at matched levels**, keep the tape **flat and snug without indenting**, take **two readings** and average them, and record **position, landmarks and side**. **True** leg length (ASIS to the tip of the medial malleolus) measures the bones. **Apparent** leg length (umbilicus to the medial malleolus) adds the effect of pelvic tilt.
text.ur: Tape measure sirf **paanch aadaton** ke saath bharosay ki hai: landmarks par skin pen se nishaan, **dono sides matched levels par**, tape **flat aur snug lekin jild mein dhansi hui nahi**, **do readings** ka average, aur **position, landmarks aur side** record. **True** leg length (ASIS se medial malleolus ki nok tak) haddiyon ko naapti hai. **Apparent** leg length (umbilicus se medial malleolus) mein pelvic tilt ka asar bhi shamil hai.

text.en: Measuring a leg is like measuring the height of a shelf in a tilted room: if the floor (pelvis) tilts, the shelf (leg) looks shorter on one side even though the boards are the same length. True length ignores the tilt, apparent length includes it. Compare the two to see where the problem is.
text.ur: Taang naapna tilted kamre mein shelf ki unchai naapne jaisa hai: agar floor (pelvis) tilt ho to shelf (leg) ek side chhoti lagti hai halankeh takhtay ek jitne hain. True length tilt ko nazar-andaz karti hai, apparent length usay shamil karti hai. Dono ko compare kar ke masla dhoondein.

intro.en: Supine with the pelvis square and the legs parallel. The tape runs from the **ASIS**, **across the inner side of the knee**, to the tip of the **medial malleolus**. Repeat on the other side: a difference of more than 1 cm is a true (structural) shortening.
intro.ur: Supine, pelvis square aur taangein parallel. Tape **ASIS** se, **knee ke andar wali side se guzar kar**, **medial malleolus** ki nok tak. Doosri side par dohrayein: 1 cm se zyada ka farq true (structural) shortening hai.

intro.en: The tape starts at the **umbilicus** (or xiphisternum) and ends at the medial malleolus. If true lengths are equal but apparent lengths differ, the cause is **pelvic obliquity** or an adduction/abduction contracture of the hip: a functional discrepancy.
intro.ur: Tape **umbilicus** (ya xiphisternum) se shuru ho kar medial malleolus par khatam hoti hai. Agar true lengths barabar hon lekin apparent mukhtalif, to wajah **pelvic obliquity** ya hip ka adduction/abduction contracture hai: functional discrepancy.

question.en: True leg lengths are equal, but apparent length is 2 cm shorter on the left. What does this suggest?
question.ur: True leg lengths barabar hain lekin apparent length left par 2 cm kam hai. Yeh kya batata hai?

text.en: A functional discrepancy, for example a pelvic tilt or hip contracture, not a short bone
text.ur: Functional discrepancy, maslan pelvic tilt ya hip contracture, chhoti haddi nahi

feedback.en: Yes — equal true length with unequal apparent length points to the pelvis or hip, so look at pelvic tilt, scoliosis and hip adduction contracture.
feedback.ur: Haan — barabar true length aur na-barabar apparent length pelvis ya hip ki taraf ishara karti hai, is liye pelvic tilt, scoliosis aur hip adduction contracture dekhein.

feedback.en: A short femur would shorten the true length.
feedback.ur: Chhota femur true length ko chhota karta.

feedback.en: A short tibia would also shorten the true length.
feedback.ur: Chhota tibia bhi true length ko chhota karta.

intro.en: Supine, hips and knees bent, feet flat and level. Look from the side: if one knee sits **lower**, the tibia is shorter; if it sits **further back**, the femur is shorter. Use the **Result** options to compare.
intro.ur: Supine, hips aur knees mode hue, pair flat aur level. Side se dekhein: ek knee **neeche** ho to tibia chhota; **peechay** ho to femur chhota. **Result** options se compare karein.

intro.en: Mark **10 cm above the upper pole of the patella** on both thighs, wrap the tape flat and snug and read both. More than 1–2 cm difference suggests quadriceps wasting (or swelling). Re-measure at the same level at every visit.
intro.ur: Dono thighs par **patella ke upper pole se 10 cm upar** nishaan lagayein, tape ko flat aur snug lapetein aur dono parhein. 1–2 cm se zyada farq quadriceps wasting (ya swelling) batata hai. Har visit par usi level par dobara naapein.

title.ur: Kaun sa measure kis masle ke liye?

rows.en: More than 1 cm difference = structural shortening
rows.ur: 1 cm se zyada farq = structural shortening

rows.en: Is it the pelvis or a contracture?
Equal true but unequal apparent = functional discrepancy; blocks under the short leg until the ASISs level give its size
rows.ur: True barabar lekin apparent na-barabar = functional discrepancy; chhoti taang ke neeche blocks jab tak ASIS level na ho uska size batate hain

rows.en: Girth at the joint line plus sweep or patellar tap
rows.ur: Joint line par girth aur sweep ya patellar tap

rows.en: About 1 cm bigger = effusion (confirm with the tap)
rows.ur: Takriban 1 cm bara = effusion (tap se confirm)

rows.en: Figure-of-eight over the navicular and malleoli
rows.ur: Navicular aur malleoli ke upar figure-of-eight

text.en: **Using the wrong landmarks or a tape that moves.** The ASIS is easy to confuse with the iliac crest, and the tape slides if it is not held at both ends; a loose tape under-reads and a tight one indents the skin. Measure with the legs in the same position (the pelvis square, hips neutral) and mark the points with a pen. Never compare a measurement taken in a different position with the last visit.
text.ur: **Ghalat landmarks ya khiskti tape.** ASIS ko iliac crest se milaana aasan hai, aur tape agar dono sirey se na pakri ho to khisak jati hai; dheeli tape kam parhti hai aur kasi hui jild mein dhansti hai. Taangon ko ek jaisi position mein (pelvis square, hips neutral) rakh kar naapein aur points ko pen se mark karein. Kisi mukhtalif position mein li gayi reading ko pichli visit se kabhi compare na karein.

question.en: A knee measures 1.5 cm larger than the other at the joint line after a twisting injury two hours ago. What next?
question.ur: Do ghante pehle twisting injury ke baad knee joint line par doosre se 1.5 cm bara naapa gaya. Aage kya?

text.en: Confirm with a sweep or patellar tap and consider early imaging and referral for a possible haemarthrosis
text.ur: Sweep ya patellar tap se confirm karein aur mumkina haemarthrosis ke liye early imaging aur referral par ghor karein

feedback.en: Yes — rapid swelling within a couple of hours suggests blood in the joint (ACL tear, fracture), which needs medical assessment.
feedback.ur: Haan — do ghante ke andar tezi se soojan joint mein khoon (ACL tear, fracture) batati hai, jis ka medical assessment zaroori hai.

text.en: Reassure that the swelling is normal
text.ur: Tasalli dein ke soojan normal hai

feedback.en: Rapid swelling after a twist is a red flag, not reassurance.
feedback.ur: Twist ke baad tezi se soojan red flag hai, tasalli nahi.

text.en: Start strong stretching to reduce swelling
text.ur: Soojan ghatane ke liye zor ki stretching

feedback.en: Stretching an acutely swollen, injured joint can worsen the damage.
feedback.ur: Acutely sooje hue zakhmi joint ko stretch karne se nuksan barh sakta hai.

text.en: **Numbers that change management.** A structural leg-length difference of 1–2 cm with back pain: trial of a heel raise. Calf more than 2–3 cm bigger than the other after surgery, with tenderness: possible DVT — refer the same day. Arm girth 2 cm bigger after breast cancer treatment: lymphoedema, refer to the lymphoedema service. Quadriceps wasting after knee injury: progressive strengthening with re-measure in four weeks.
text.ur: **Woh numbers jo management badal dete hain.** 1–2 cm structural leg-length farq aur kamar dard: heel raise ka trial. Surgery ke baad calf doosri se 2–3 cm se zyada bara aur tenderness: mumkina DVT — usi din refer. Breast cancer ke ilaaj ke baad arm girth 2 cm bara: lymphoedema, lymphoedema service ko refer. Knee ki chot ke baad quadriceps wasting: progressive strengthening aur chaar haftay baad re-measure.

question.en: Why measure two readings and use the same tester when tracking girth?
question.ur: Girth track karte hue do readings aur wohi tester kyun?

answer.en: Because inter-tester error (often 0.5–1 cm) is larger than intra-tester error; a 1 cm change may be your tape, not the limb. Same landmarks, same tension, ideally the same person, and write the level in centimetres from a bony point so a colleague can repeat it.
answer.ur: Kyunke inter-tester error (aksar 0.5–1 cm) ek hi tester ke error se zyada hai; 1 cm ki tabdeeli aap ki tape ho sakti hai, limb nahi. Same landmarks, same tension, behtar hai same shakhs, aur level ko bony point se centimetres mein likhein taake colleague dohra sake.

question.en: Which landmark is the starting point of **true** leg length?
question.ur: **True** leg length ka starting point kaun sa landmark hai?

feedback.en: Yes — true length runs from the ASIS to the medial malleolus.
feedback.ur: Haan — true length ASIS se medial malleolus tak hoti hai.
Yeh apparent length shuru karta hai.

feedback.en: That is not used for these tape measures.
feedback.ur: Yeh in tape measures ke liye use nahi hota.

text.en: **Refer the same day** for a swollen, tender, warm calf after surgery, immobility or travel (DVT), a rapidly enlarging arm after cancer treatment, a leg that is cold and pale, or a hot swollen joint with fever. Do not massage or stretch a suspected DVT.
text.ur: **Usi din refer karein** surgery, immobility ya safar ke baad sooji, tender, garam calf (DVT), cancer ke ilaaj ke baad tezi se barhta arm, thandi aur peeli taang, ya garam sooja joint bukhar ke saath. Shak-e-DVT ko malish ya stretch na karein.

summary.en: Five tape habits: mark landmarks, match both sides, tape flat and snug, average two readings, record position and landmarks.
summary.ur: Paanch tape aadatein: landmarks mark karein, dono sides match karein, tape flat aur snug, do readings ka average, position aur landmarks record karein.

summary.en: True length (ASIS → medial malleolus) shows structural shortening; apparent length adds pelvic tilt; Galeazzi finds femur versus tibia.
summary.ur: True length (ASIS → medial malleolus) structural shortening dikhati hai; apparent length mein pelvic tilt shamil; Galeazzi femur vs tibia batata hai.

summary.en: Girth and swelling numbers (thigh, knee, calf, ankle, arm) change management; a calf over 2–3 cm bigger or rapid swelling needs urgent assessment.
summary.ur: Girth aur swelling ke numbers (thigh, knee, calf, ankle, arm) management badalte hain; calf 2–3 cm se bara ya tezi se soojan urgent assessment chahti hai.

front.en: Starting and ending landmarks of true leg length?
front.ur: True leg length ke starting aur ending landmarks?

back.en: ASIS to the tip of the medial malleolus (across the inner side of the knee).
back.ur: ASIS se medial malleolus ki nok tak (knee ki andar wali side se).

front.en: Equal true length but unequal apparent length means?
front.ur: Barabar true length lekin na-barabar apparent length ka matlab?

back.en: A functional discrepancy: pelvic obliquity or a hip adduction/abduction contracture.
back.ur: Functional discrepancy: pelvic obliquity ya hip adduction/abduction contracture.

front.en: Where do you measure thigh girth?

back.en: 10 cm above the upper pole of the patella, the same level on both sides.
back.ur: Patella ke upper pole se 10 cm upar, dono sides par wohi level.

front.en: What does a Galeazzi test with one lower knee show?
front.ur: Ek neechay knee wala Galeazzi test kya dikhata hai?

back.en: A shorter tibia on that side (further-back knee = shorter femur).
back.ur: Us side ka tibia chhota (peechay wala knee = chhota femur).
